lines.1: 「Oh, that reminds me. Give me one too--a Kiriya Stamp.」
lines.4: 「Now, listen. I said it would grant any wish, but I never said when I would grant it.」
lines.5: 「A hundred years from now, or three hundred million...」
lines.7: 「I don't plan to use such a cheap trick. As long as you don't ask the impossible, I'll grant it.」
lines.8: 「And any wish of yours that isn't impossible is something I'd grant without making you collect stamps in the first place.」
